title: Petition to the Holy Trinity
text:
Most Holy Trinity,
Godhead indivisible, Father,
Son, and Holy Spirit,
our first beginning and our last end,
since Thou hast made us
after Thine own image and likeness,
grant that all the thoughts of our minds,
all the words of our tongues,
all the affections of our hearts
and all our actions may be always conformed to Thy most Holy Will,
to the end that after having seen Thee
here below in appearances and by means of faith,
we may come at last to contemplate Thee
face-to-face in the perfect possession of Thee
forever in paradise.
Amen.
notes: Text as distributed in the 'Catholic Prayers' Android app (richarddean.angeles.catholicprayers).
